question: How many women boxers from India won gold medals in the Women's World Boxing Championship 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **4 women boxers** from India won gold medals in the Women's World Boxing Championship 2023.
 
• They are **Saweety Boora, Nitu Ghanghas, Nikhat Zareen and Lovlina Borgohain.**
 
• The Women's World Boxing Championship 2023 saw a remarkable performance by Indian women boxers.
 
• This achievement highlights the growing talent and dedication of female athletes in India.
 
• It serves as an inspiration for young girls across the country to pursue sports and strive for excellence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Women's World Boxing Championship is an annual event organized by the **International Boxing Association (AIBA).**
 
• It is one of the most prestigious competitions in the sport of boxing for women.
 
• India has consistently performed well in this championship, producing world-class boxers.
 
• The success of Indian women boxers in international arenas has led to increased support and investment in the sport within the country.
